ov: طرد الأرواح من إيميلي روز (الإنجليزية: The Exorcism of Emily Rose) هو فيلم رعب خارق للطبيعة وجريمة ودراما أمريكي، من إخراج سكوت ديركسون سنة 2005، وبطولة لورا ليني وتوم ويلكينسون. يعتمد الفيلم على قصة أناليس ميشيل. يتصرف الفيلم في سياق متجدد لأعمال مثل رواية طارد الأرواح، وفيلم طارد الأرواح الشريرة عام 1973، الذي يتعامل مع الموضوعات نفسها.
plotEn:
Erin Bruner, an ambitious lawyer seeking promotion to senior partner, takes the case of Father Richard Moore, a Catholic diocesan priest charged with negligent homicide following an attempted exorcism of 19-year-old student Emily Rose. The archdiocese wants Moore to plead guilty to limit public attention, but he instead pleads not guilty. During the trial, witnesses' statements are shown through flashbacks.
Prosecutor Ethan Thomas questions doctors and neurologists to establish a medical explanation for Emily's death, particularly epilepsy and schizophrenia. Emily had abandoned her college studies after suffering recurrent delusions and muscle spasms at 3 a.m. She returned home and was treated with epilepsy and psychosis medication. When her condition failed to improve, Moore was consulted. Based on his observations, he concluded that Emily was experiencing demonic possession. With her parents' consent, he performed an exorcism, which failed. Moore believed her medication had prevented the demon's expulsion by suppressing her brain activity.
Determined to tell Emily's story, Moore testifies in court. Bruner subsequently experiences supernatural phenomena at home, repeatedly waking at 3 a.m. to the smell of burning material. Moore warns that she may have become a target, explaining that he experienced similar phenomena while preparing the exorcism.
